_about: Visit schedules for rolling-recruitment (Emeritus) studies, copied unchanged from RAYDAR Original (built there from each protocol's schedule of assessments). Day 1 is the anchor; a visit has a study day and a window in days (win before, winAfter after if different), or a dayFrom/dayTo range. type phone = no clinic visit. byCode maps a study code (as in the eSource file name or the original RAYDAR) to its schedule. Public holidays and weekends count as closed days.

223977.label: GSK 223977 — Bronchiectasis (Anti-inflammatory)
223977.note: Protocol Final 27 May 2025, Table 3 (2 doses: Day 1 and Week 12). Days are counted as the protocol prints them from Day 1 (Week 12 = 84 days after Day 1, matching the 12-week dose interval). The Week 58 phone follow-up for women of child-bearing potential has no day or window in the protocol, so it is not checked.

gsbr12.label: GSBR-1290-12 - Aleniglipron, Obesity/Overweight + Comorbidity (Gasherbrum)
gsbr12.note: Protocol Amendment 1, schedule of assessments. The protocol gives visit weeks, not days; the day shown is 7 x week + 1 (Week 0 = Day 1), the same rule used for the other calculator studies. Screening is up to 4 weeks. Treatment is 76 weeks and the end of study visit is 1 week after the last visit of the treatment period. Scheduled visits are fasting (8 hours) clinic visits, except the telehealth visits at Weeks 40, 52, 56, 64 and 68 (shown as Phone). A telehealth visit may be converted to an office visit. An early discontinuation visit is done only if the participant stops, so it is not listed. The DXA substudy (select sites only) is done within about 21 days before Visit 1.

visits.name: Screening
visits.note: Protocol: Screening period of up to 4 weeks before Visit 1. Fasting (8 hours) is required, so screening activities may be split over more than 1 day.

visits.name: Day 533 - Visit 20, Week 76, end of treatment
Day 541 - End of study visit, Week 77
